observations.name: intro-1
observations.text:
FarmTact

A FIRST SEASON YOU CAN FINISH

Plan the farm.
Watch it respond.

Learn production planning through one small order, one clear choice and its recorded consequences.

01 · YOUR GOAL
Keep one promise

Guide a tiny Singapore farm from a confirmed order to a recorded delivery.

Illustrated example · not a live farm reading
02 · YOUR CHOICES
Compare two plans

See how each growing plan uses the little farm, then make one clear choice.

Illustrated example · your season will show its own choices
03 · CONSEQUENCES
See the farm respond

Maintenance and delivery show what each decision changes without touching real operations.

Illustrated example · simulation only
